ownLineAliases.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path #116: Fangs of War
ownLineAliases.rationale: Plan §7, a title-form case: the book's SOURCELONG is 'Ironfang Invasion, Chapter 2 - Fangs of War' (ap116.pcc), and its block's only Paizo line (adventure_path/ironfang_invasion/ap116/OGL.txt:63) names it by the adventure path volume title. PCGen's own conversion line (:65) names the dataset 'Pathfinder Adventure Path #116: Fangs of War' too. Reviewed through this book's confirmation.

ownLineAliases.title: Lords of Chaos, Book of the Damned, Vol. 2
ownLineAliases.rationale: Plan §7, a title-form case: the book's SOURCELONG is 'Lords of Chaos, Book of the Damned, Volume 2' and its proposed Registry title reads 'Lords of Chaos: Book of the Damned, Vol. 2.'. Its block's Paizo line (campaign_setting/book_of_the_damned_volume_2/OGL.txt:39) reads 'Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Lords of Chaos, Book of the Damned, Vol. 2.', the title form PCGen's conversion line uses as well. Reviewed through this book's confirmation.
